info.title: IQ11
info.description: The iQ11 API allows you to generate a unique URL to embed into your application using an iFrame. End users will use this to log in to their online banking and select a bank account to make a payment from.

post.description: This endpoint is used to generate a unique URL to embed into your application using an iFrame. End users will use this to log in to their online banking and select a bank account to make a payment from. For additional details on iQ11 and RedirectMethod, please visit our [Iq11 Overview](https://docs.vopay.com/docs/iq11-overview)

ClientAccountID.description: When provided, the bank account submitted will be attached to the Client Account ID

RedirectURL.description: URL to redirect to after the customer logs in to their online banking account. The bank account token will be passed as a GET parameter, for example https://redirect.com/page?Token=1234. If not provided, RedirectMethod defaults to javascriptmessage.

CompanyName.description: Name of the Company. Defaults to the account name if not provided.

Language.description: Language of iQ11 iFrame- en (English) or fr (French). Default value is en (English)

RedirectMethod.description: This parameter accepts InnerRedirect, OuterRedirect, and JavascriptMessage as parameter values. Defaults to innerredirect if RedirectURL is provided, otherwise javascriptmessage.

AccountSelectionMethod.description: This parameter accepts any, online and manual as parameter values. Defaults to any.

PaymentSelectionMethod.description: This parameter accepts any, bank, email, credit, debitcard, googlepay, applepay, paypal, or venmo as parameter values. Defaults to any.

ClientControlled.description: When set to true, the connected bank account will be linked to your VoPay account. Default is false.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number to associate with the bank account.

Country.description: This parameter accepts country codes [CA, US]. Default is CA

RequireDebitAuthorityAgreement.description: This parameter will determine if we display a debit authority agreement to the end-user before they connect their payment method. You must request this feature to be enabled for your account. Default is true.

Verify.description: A comma-separated list of payment methods to verify once the user has connected their payment method. Allowed values are: 'bank', 'interacbasic', 'interacenhanced', 'cardbasic', 'cardenhanced'. If no value is provided, no verification will be performed.

CardTypeValidation.description: When set to true, the card type will be validated to ensure the entered information represents the selected card option. Default is false.

Trigger3DS.description: When set to true, 3DS authentication will be triggered during the card addition process. Default is false.

AcceptedCardBrands.description: A comma-separated list of accepted card brands to restrict which cards can be added.

AccountHolderType.description: The type of account holder. Used to restrict the type of bank account that can be connected.

DarkMode.description: When set to true, the iFrame will be displayed in dark mode. Default is false.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

EmbedURL.description: Custom generated iQ11 iframe url for users to use

IframeKey.description: Unique key attached to the generated iFrame

get.description: This endpoint is used to return the payment details associated with an iQ11 Token.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

MaskedAccount.description: The last four digits of a Bank account number. For example: ****1234

Bank.description: Three digit institution number of a Canadian bank.

TransitNumber.description: Five digit branch transit number of a Canadian bank.

ABARoutingNumber.description: ABA Routing number of a US bank.

FullName.description: Full name of the account holder.

TokenType.description: The type of the token; either manual or iq11.

EmailAddress.description: Email address of the account holder.

PhoneNumber.description: Phone number of the account holder.

Question.description: Question provided to the account holder.

Answer.description: Answer provided to the account holder.

AutoDepositEnabled.description: True if auto deposit is enabled, false if it is not. Used for Interac only.

CredtCardType.description: Credit card connection types. Valid values are: 'creditcard', 'googlepay', 'applepay'

Type.description: Payment method type. Valid values are 'bank', 'email', 'credit', 'debit'

post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit payment method details (bank account, email address), and will return a token which can be used to perform transactions.

AccountHolderName.description: String that defines the account holder name. Used for all payment methods.

FinancialInstitutionNumber.description: Three digit institution number for a Canadian bank account.

BranchTransitNumber.description: Five digit branch transit number for a Canadian bank account.

ABARoutingNumber.description: Nine digit ABA Routing number of a US bank account.

FlinksAccountID.description: Flinks Account ID. Must be accompanied by a FlinksLoginID. VoPay will fetch the associated bank account details from Flinks.

FlinksLoginID.description: Flinks Login ID. Must be accompanied by a FlinksAccountID. VoPay will fetch the associated bank account details from Flinks.

PlaidProcessorToken.description: Plaid Processor Token. VoPay will fetch the associated bank account details from Plaid.

MxProcessorToken.description: Mx Processor Token. VoPay will fetch the associated bank account details from Mx.

Address1.description: First line of the address. Ex: 123 Main St.

VerifyAccount.description: When set to true, the connected bank account will be verified. Default is false. Only applicable when Flinks or Plaid credentials are provided.

Language.description: Language - en (English) or fr (French). Default value is en (English)

Message.description: Message sent to recipient (used for Interac)

ClientControlled.description: When set to true, the connected bank account will be linked to your VoPay account. Default is false.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number to associate with the bank account.

Type.description: The type of payment method you are tokenizing. Valid values are: 'bank', 'email'. Default is 'bank'.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

Token.description: A codify variable that contains the bank account

get.description: This endpoint is used to return the transaction history associated with an iQ11 Token.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: Your iQ11 Token that has been generated using Custom iFrame.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

Transactions.description: JSON payload containing the bank account's transaction history
Transactions.example: { 0: { Id: 13bd9695-1686-472f-b6f8-a36a7547c51b, Code: null, Date: 2021-12-06, Debit: 1500, Credit: null, Balance: 1261.34, Description: Rent Payment }, 1: { Id: 0bcd3935-8e9a-4b90-a4c1-c662ff240d55, Code: null, Date: 2021-12-01, Debit: 141.03, Credit: null, Balance: 1121.31, Description: Groceries } }

LastRetrievedTime.description: The date and time the transaction history was retrieved for the assoicated bank account.

get.description: This endpoint is used to return the bank account balance associated with an iQ11 Token.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: Your iQ11 Token that has been generated using Custom iFrame.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

AccountBalance.description: The balance of the associated bank account

BalanceAsAtDate.description: The date and time the balance was retrieved from the associated bank account.

post.description: This endpoint is used to enrich transaction data associated with a iQ11 Token.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: Your iQ11 Token that has associated transactions to be enriched.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

RequestID.description: A unique identifier for the data enrichemnt process.

get.description: This endpoint is used to fetch transaction reports generated from the enriched data.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: Your iQ11 Token that has enriched data associated with it.

parameters.name: EnrichedDataType
parameters.description: The type of report you want to generate, valid types are: credit-transactions, employment-credit-transactions, government-credit-transactions, tax-credit-transactions, debit-transactions, rent-debit-transactions, utility-debit-transactions, telecom-debit-transactions, loan-debit-transactions, insurance-debit-transactions, bank-fee-transactions, subscription-debit-transactions, nsf-fee-transactions, transaction-report, risk-report.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

EnrichedData.description: A generated report containing transaction analysis and insights.

DateOfFirstTransaction.description: The date of the earliest transaction in the dataset

DateOfLastTransaction.description: The date of the most recent transaction in the dataset

TotalNumberOfTransactions.description: The total count of transactions in the dataset

AveragePayment.description: The average amount across all payments

AverageDaysBetweenPayments.description: The average number of days between consecutive payments

LastTwoPaymentDates.description: The dates of the two most recent payments

TotalAmount.description: The sum of all transaction amounts

get.description: This endpoint is used to check the status of a data enrichment request.

parameters.name: RequestID
parameters.description: The unique identifier returned from the /iq11/enrich-data POST call

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

Status.description: The current status of the data enrichment process

PercentComplete.description: The percentage of transactions that have been enriched

EnrichedCount.description: The number of transactions that have been enriched

TotalCount.description: The total number of transactions in the dataset
